Definition: to peep, i.e. glance sharply at
BiblicalUsage: To glance sharply is to look with intent, and the word is used for watchers on both sides of heaven. The nations shall narrowly look upon the fallen king of Babylon and ask if this is the man who made the earth tremble, the LORD looks from His habitation upon all the inhabitants of the earth, and the beloved looks forth at the windows.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God sees with a sharp eye, and the day will come when the nations look sharply at the proud and find nothing left to fear.
